name: tn11_22_water_occupant_bounds
description: TN15: a network occupant message makes r = the occupant's bounding city cells dirty when the cell (r.x1, r.z1) is under water (the NW corner only), dirty U= r, not grown and not clamped. An 8 x 8 city: water (under water) at (2..7, 0), the map updated by DoPostCityInit; then row z = 1 becomes navigable (not under water) under a clean map. Occupant 1 at (2,0) with bounding cells (1,0)-(2,1): the NW cell (1,0) is dry although its own cell is under water, so nothing is dirty. Occupant 2 at (3,1) with bounding (2,0)-(3,1): NW (2,0) is under water, dirty = (2,0)-(3,1). Occupant 3 at (6,0) with bounding (6,0)-(9,1), past the map edge: dirty = the union (2,0)-(9,1), not clamped. The update then refreshes (2..7, 1) to 200 and leaves (0,1) and (1,1) at 0.
